meta.title: Crawford County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Crawford County's 2026 appropriation ordinance (No. 2025-33, amended) as filed with the state. We use the amounts the ordinance appropriates, with category detail from its attachments. The pages are scanned images, so every number was read by eye and checked against the printed totals.

nodes.name: ADEM - Sales Tax Public Safety
nodes.note: Section 4 of the ordinance (p. 2) appropriates $46,000.00; Attachment "C" (p. 22) lists supplies $40,000 and capital outlay $3,000, total $43,000.00. Printed total is $46,000.00; the categories listed add to $43,000.00.
